basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and avid gamer from Salt Lake City, Utah. I love diving into discussions about the latest in tech and gaming, especially on platforms like PlayStation. When I'm not gaming or troubleshooting tech issues (like the frustrating PSNow subscription errors), I'm exploring outdoor activities. I'm married and work as a software developer, which keeps me online mostly in the evenings after 6 PM MST. I enjoy unwinding with a good game or browsing Reddit for interesting threads.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from the University of Utah. My expertise in technology is further enriched by my job as a software developer, where I constantly engage with the latest tech. I'm self-taught in gaming and stay updated on the latest trends through online communities.
